say:2:1421127001:1.text: Phew, just watching the swords clash is terrifying enough...
say:2:1421127001:1.source_cn: 呼啊，我没有练过剑术，但光是看着刀光剑影，就觉得很害怕了……

say:3:1421127002:1.text: Mind you, this was just the first round, and people could die in it...
say:3:1421127002:1.source_cn: 这才只是第一轮，而且当时的要求还是生死不论。

say:4:1421127003:1.text: We can only imagine how dangerous the real thing was...
say:4:1421127003:1.source_cn: 就算席蕾安排的测试强度差不多，但烈度比起当年肯定差距很...

choice_prompt:5:1421127003.text: We can only imagine how dangerous the real thing was...

say:6:1421127004:1.text: Indeed. For Indris and the other participants back then, this round was far beyond just a battle.
say:6:1421127004:1.source_cn: 是的，对于当时的因度厄他们来说，这考验的难度既是战斗，...

say:7:1421127006:1.text: What about the participants back then? Many of them had never touched a sword before, much less sparred with seasoned warriors.
say:7:1421127006:1.source_cn: 那时很多人，甚至是人生第一次拿起刀剑，更别提还要与经验...

say:8:1421127007:1.text: The so-called judges were either nobles or senior generals chosen by Thador, and they all considered the Imperator's proposal to be humiliating.
say:8:1421127007:1.source_cn: 所谓的考官不是贵族子弟，就是都铎甄选出来的老将，本来就...

say:9:1421127008:1.text: They were merciless to the participants, even going as far as taunting them...
say:9:1421127008:1.source_cn: 所以面对对手，他们绝不会手下留情，反而会愈发残忍，甚至...

say:11:1421127010:1.text: When Indris made it through, everyone was shocked...
say:11:1421127010:1.source_cn: 正因如此，因度厄能够过关，对于所有人来说，都是一种震撼。

say:12:1421127011:1.text: Alright, let's move on to the next round. In case you're wondering, there were no breaks between rounds back then.
say:12:1421127011:1.source_cn: 我们去看下一项测试吧，按当时的标准，是没有休息时间的。

say:13:1421127012:1.text: The participants only had time to bandage their wounds quickly before the next round started—a so-called test of physical endurance and agility.
say:13:1421127012:1.source_cn: 战斗胜利后，最多只能简单地包扎下伤口，然后就要进入下一...

say:15:1421127005:1.text: That's right. Otivia, you might not know anything about swordsmanship, but at least you've witnessed your fair share of duels in your youth...
